CustomField.description: SC-3384: raw per-unit USD net stamped by the Attribute-Based Adjustment (ABA) step in the pricing procedure, captured BEFORE multi-currency localization. Non-null marks a line whose net was set by the currency-blind ABA Override decision table (0lDa50000007BEuEAM). Carries from QuoteLineItem on convert so the order-side reprice (which does not re-run the ESD) stays provenance-based and idempotent. Read by the currency-correction pass in PartnerNetPricePosthook.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Raw per-unit USD net from the attribute-based adjustment, before currency localization. System field.
CustomField.label: ABA Raw Net (USD)
